title: Inspect Naive Bayes metrics and reused AUC
description: You distinguish newly computed predictions from an existing metric variable.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You fit GaussianNB and predict test labels. The recording reports accuracy and F1.

steps.question: Does this block compute a new roc_auc value for Naive Bayes?
steps.answer: It prints the existing roc_auc variable. The roc_curve call receives predicted labels y_pred_nb and does not assign roc_auc.

steps.description: You plot rates calculated from those hard labels. The legend inserts the existing AUC value, which prints as 0.953 in the recording.
You compute a confusion matrix from y_test and y_pred_nb and display integer counts. This matrix uses the Naive Bayes predictions made in this block.
